extensions: Owner approved 120 minutes to complete sixteen families and three pairs

poolBudget.procedure: Only one temporary application may run at a time; retain existing reserve/caps. Stop and verify its deployment before starting the other region.

methodology.planned: Three complete matched pairs, one initial and twenty steady samples per family. Stop on pool pressure, lock backlog, 429 or 5xx.
methodology.actual: US West completed sixteen families (16 initial + 320 steady successful reads). Singapore completed 16 initial + 156 steady successful reads, then one failed Current Seating read at round 10. Remaining requests/pairs were not attempted.
methodology.percentile: Nearest-rank within each cohort, successful steady reads only. Initial probes and the failed attempt remain separately retained; unequal partial cohorts are not full matched acceptance.
methodology.failedSampleMetadata: The original error sample lacks phase/round because the operator loop attaches them after a successful await. Canonical TSV explicitly marks phase steady-inferred / round 10 from preceding saved sample and known loop order; the original sample is unchanged.
methodology.placement: Selected Railway runtime metadata is retained with exact deployment/image identity. Historical redeploy manifests differed from runtime-region metadata during setup. /proc/1/environ returned EACCES; that check is not claimed. A separate upstream-zone HTTP fence was prepared but Singapore stopped before that fence, so it is not claimed.
methodology.nativeObserver: Twenty read-only SELECT 1 RTT samples per measured region; first US West probe overlapped early HTTP work. Other fixed probes precede their HTTP cohort. No pure lock wait or request-exclusive CPU inference.

native.label: singapore-1
native.source: Railway SSH-selected runtime container; /proc/1 metadata denial is retained explicitly

cors.source: Loopback HTTP request to the actual runtime; public TLS checked by remote HTTP campaign

failedRequest.attribution: Request-correlated acquire 2001.050 ms, wall 2004.191 ms, one acquire, zero submitted SQL, observed pool maxActive=1/maxIdle=0/maxWaiting=1. The generic Error log supplies no driver/Prisma code. This establishes failed acquisition, not the identity of the holder or root cause; a connection attempt can also be part of acquisition.
failedRequest.followUp: PERF-13 already retains an earlier intermittent US West Seating 500. Do not call this Singapore-only or fixed by later 200s.

before.source: Operator via existing IPv4 pooler for the same project/database; runtime uses direct IPv6 endpoint. Not container RTT.

after.source: Operator via existing IPv4 pooler for the same project/database; runtime uses direct IPv6 endpoint. Not container RTT.

firstOperatorRequest.methodology: Sequential round-robin, one initial + twenty steady reads per family, 750ms minimum start spacing, fail-stop on unexpected status/25s/transport. Only session writes; no business/provider writes.

firstCampaign.authorization: Direct human selected existing production with synthetic demo data, unchanged original wedding-be service; bounded temporary experiment approved.
firstCampaign.adaptation: One built temporary runtime reused sequentially across regions to pin one immutable image. Second empty service has never deployed; deletion request was refused by connector and was not retried through another channel. Both service configurations will be archived, not deleted.

ownedOrphanRecovery.reason: First operator harness incorrectly required caller request ID to equal server-generated ID. Login succeeded before the harness retained its token. Recover only that owned session through the normal session inventory/revocation API.

notes: An initial caller-versus-server request-ID assertion failed after a successful login; normal API inventory/revocation recovered the exact owned session.
A sessionId field correction and stopped-runtime recovery failure are preserved separately.

New-service Config-as-Code, replica-zero validation, historical region-manifest checks, setup rebuilds and a Hobby multi-region validation failure are retained. No setup failure is counted as a measured successful regional cohort.

The extra empty service never deployed. Connector refused deletion; it was not retried through another channel. Both services are stopped archived resources with no copied credentials or attached source.
The measured cohorts use the exact same image despite excluded setup builds having different image digests.

limits: No complete repeated regional comparison or latency SLA; no production region switch.
No paid generation, mail/push delivery, payment checkout/callback or object mutation, new fixture or migration.
Assigned Staff success remains historical actual-window PERF-02 evidence; no event window was altered.
Storage proof is one retained 237-byte object with matching checksum, not representative throughput.
Normal derived Analytics publications and session/audit writes are separate from unchanged business digests.
Analytics mixes warm and refresh generations; retain query counts and warm-only views instead of treating all requests as equal work.
